name: FA_PRODUCTION_INTERFACE
description: FA_PRODUCTION_INTERFACE contains information on production details for assets.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Asset identifier. Use asset inquiry in any assets work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date for production details. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be earlier than END_DATE.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date for production details. Must be later than START_DATE.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Error message from posting program.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the periodic production upload. Valid values: NEW, POST, ON HOLD. NEW means the asset is new. POST means the asset is ready to post. ON HOLD means the asset needs further review.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: User-defined description of the periodic production entry. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset book for the asset. Use the Manage Asset Books task to identify valid values.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: request ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated. Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
